# IntroFinRbookQuarto

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This is the GitHub repository for the book Introduction to *Computational Finance and Financial
Econometrics with R* by Eric Zivot. This book is build using Quarto and this repository contains the source code for the book.
